title: Event envelope
description: Every message on the bus carries this envelope. Consumers route on `type` and deduplicate on `id`; the payload shape is defined by the schema named in `type`.

id.description: Unique per event. Delivery is at-least-once, so consumers MUST treat this as an idempotency key.

version.description: Payload schema version. Bump on any breaking change; publish both versions during a migration window.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, not when it was published. Ordering is not guaranteed by the bus.

producer.description: Service that emitted it. For debugging and for cycle detection in event chains.

correlation_id.description: Ties every event caused by one user action together. Propagate it unchanged through the whole chain.

causation_id.description: The id of the event that directly caused this one. Correlation gives you the trace; causation gives you the edges.

tenant_id.description: Owning team/account. Consumers MUST scope every query by it — this is the multi-tenancy boundary.

project_id.description: Owning project (a website under a tenant).

payload.description: Shape defined by the matching schema in this directory.
